scope: Geometric hit criteria only. Other event-level selection, trigger, hit efficiency and reconstruction behavior are not implemented by these criteria.

2015.count_definition: 3D station point: at least one axial and at least one stereo sensor intersected within the same station and detector half; hole/slot alternatives are unioned per view.
2015.contiguity_status: No consecutive-station requirement is established by the inspected note; the geometric model counts qualifying stations.
2015.adoption_status: Uses the archived internal-note convention. The published 2015 paper differs by describing first-two-layer hits on both tracks.

2016.count_definition: 3D space point formed from axial and stereo strip clusters, represented geometrically by a paired station intersection.
2016.contiguity_status: The paper describes seeds from different layer triplets and extension to other layers; no contiguity condition stated.
2016.adoption_status: Published reconstruction minimum, with no additional mandatory L1/L2 requirement in the v5.0.4 prompt-selection summary.

2021.count_definition: Individual 2D sensor-plane hits, unioning alternative sensors in each view; paired 3D stations are not required for the hit count.
2021.adoption_status: Authoritative current user correction supersedes the older v5.0.4 statements for this study. No mandatory inner station has been added.
